## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō lǎo nǚrén jīng* (T559) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by Zhī Qiān 支謙 ([支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99)). It opens a small "old woman" cluster ([KR6i0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0191)–0193) in which an aged woman becomes the Buddha's interlocutor on questions of life, death, and aging.

**Abstract**

A short sūtra in which an old woman queries the Buddha about the four sufferings (birth, aging, illness, death). Translation dated to Zhī Qiān's Wú productive period (222–252 CE).
